name: Hero
description: the hero: an armoured knight in battered dark iron plate with brass trim, cracked here and there with glowing orange seams, a plain closed helm with a crest and two glowing orange eye slits, tattered maroon cloth hanging from the belt, heavy gauntlets and greaves, carrying a huge rocket launcher on his shoulder whose glowing orange chambers light the armour; broad, tired, unimpressed posture; exactly the look of his existing Idle sprite (the source videos in SickOfItGamePlayer)
notes: Hero clips for Docs/ArtPipeline.md, 'Hero clips'. The hero is the ARMOURED KNIGHT with the glowing launcher (Idle.mp4 in SickOfItGamePlayer), never a man in a jacket or coat. Cells are 604x340, centre pivot, 100 pixels per unit (Unity spriteScale 0.25), exactly the existing hero sheets, so he never changes size; every pose starts from the Idle reference ('referenceIdle': true, node Tools/Art/art.mjs hero --hero-ref idle). 'wired' per clip says what player.json does today: 'own' = its state plays its own sheet; 'standIn' = the state exists but plays another sheet (see 'standIn'); false = no state in player.json yet (make the sheet, add the state: PlayerSceneClip falls back to the state's sheet). Tools/Art/art.mjs hero --check keeps this honest against player.json. Only the three climb clips have been generated; the rest wait on GPU approval.

poses.stand: standing relaxed in his armour, launcher on his shoulder, bored under the helm
poses.punchWind: leaning back with his right armoured fist cocked behind him, launcher slung on his back, glowing eyes narrowed
poses.punchHit: lunging forward, right gauntlet fully extended, body low and twisted into the punch, armour seams flaring
poses.punchHook: left gauntlet swinging round in a wide hook, shoulders turned
poses.punchUpper: rising on his toes with a gauntlet driving upward in an uppercut
poses.launcherHeld: holding the rocket launcher on his shoulder, ready to fire
poses.launcherGone: armoured hands empty and open at his sides, helm tilted down to stare flatly at them
poses.dashLean: leaning hard forward mid-sprint in his armour, one leg stretched back, maroon cloth streaming behind
poses.wallCling: pressed against a wall on his right, one gauntlet and boot on it, helm turned back over his shoulder
poses.wallKick: kicking off the wall, armoured body arched out and up, arms spread
poses.grappleAim: arm thrown forward and up, gauntlet holding a hook on a rope, other hand bracing
poses.grappleHang: hanging by one gauntlet from a rope above him, legs swinging, bored
poses.ledgeHang: hanging by both gauntlets from a ledge, greaves dangling, armour creaking
poses.ledgePull: hauling his armoured self up over a ledge, one knee on top
poses.grazeSpin: twisting out of the way, helm tilted smugly, a tiny spark trailing his pauldron
poses.victoryPose: arms crossed, launcher on his shoulder, the smallest nod of the helm
poses.deathFlat: flat on his back in his armour, eye slits dim, arms out, smoking
poses.climbHang: side view, one gauntlet raised gripping, the other low, one knee lifted high, launcher slung across his back, leaning in; no ladder drawn (the game draws it)

punch1.action: throws a quick right jab with his gauntlet, then shakes out his hand

punch2.action: swings a wide left hook, grunting

punch3.action: rises on his toes into a big finishing uppercut

launcherAway.action: the launcher is yanked from his shoulder out of frame; he looks at his empty hands, unimpressed

equipLauncher.action: swings the rocket launcher up onto his shoulder and checks it

equipFists.action: slings the launcher on his back and cracks his gauntleted knuckles

dash.action: bursts into a low forward dash in his armour, cloth streaming behind

wallSlide.action: slides slowly down the wall, scowling

wallJump.action: kicks off the wall and launches up and away

grappleThrow.action: throws the hook up and forward on a rope

grappleSwing.action: swings back and forth hanging from the rope

ledgeGrab.action: snatches a ledge with both hands and dangles

ledgeClimb.action: hauls himself up and over the ledge

graze.action: twists aside as a shot whistles past, helm tilted smugly

hurt.action: is struck, flinches back with his helm snapping to one side, armour seams flaring, then rights himself with a flat look

victory.action: nods once, looks at the camera, flatly says 'fine' with a tiny gauntlet pump

deathBurn.action: is hit, armour seams light up like a firework, goes skeletal for a flash and collapses in a puff of smoke

deathSquash.action: looks up, sighs, and is flattened into a thin pancake which peels off the ground

deathSpin.action: is launched spinning into the air, waving goodbye at the top

deathShrug.action: shrugs, says nothing, and lies down on the ground to quit

climbUp.action: climbs hand over hand in his armour, alternating arms and knees, going up

climbIdle.action: hangs still on the rungs, breathing, one bored glance of the glowing eyes

climbDown.action: climbs down hand under hand, going down
